title: Zoning text change for open space in South Richmond, Staten Island
summary: This amendment adjusts the boundaries of Designated Open Space within the Special South Richmond Development District in the Prince's Bay and Arden Heights neighborhoods of Staten Island. It also updates outdated and contradictory zoning text to align with the 2023 South Richmond Zoning Relief text amendment. A City Planning review found the change would not create new environmental impacts beyond those already studied in 2023.
